title: Read the first item and the size
objective: Use first of to get the first item of a list, and size of to count its items, including inside an if.

body.text: first of gives the first item of a list. size of gives the number of items. Both work on any list, and they do not change it.

body.title: First item and size
body.code:
make names equal to a list of "Ana", "Bo", "Cy"
say first of names
say size of names

make cards equal to a list of "a", "b", "c"
make remaining equal to (size of cards) minus 1
say remaining

body.text: first of gives back nothing when the list is empty, so check the size first before you read the first item. Here the check uses size of inside an if.

body.title: Check before reading
body.code:
make queue equal to a list of "a", "b"
if size of queue is greater than 0
    say first of queue

body.prompt: The program prints the first name but never says how many names there are. Make it print Ana and then 3.
body.starter:
make names equal to a list of "Ana", "Bo", "Cy"
say first of names
body.solution:
make names equal to a list of "Ana", "Bo", "Cy"
say first of names
say size of names
